footprints.description: E-Switch 500 series SPDT slide switch, straight PC pins (M2) or wire wrap (M5x), 3 pins 4.70 mm apart in a line
footprints.note: 500.pdf p.2 (SPDT end view 'TERM. NOS. FOR REFERENCE ONLY', side view and M2/M5 termination drawings). The datasheet has NO PC-mounting drawing for M2/M5, so the terminal positions are used as hole centres: 3 terminals in a line along the slide axis, .185 (4.70) apart, centred on the .260 (6.60) wide x .500 (12.70) long case; terminal tail 0.030 (0.76) thick, narrowed to .050 (1.27) wide at the tip (p.2 M2 P.C. MOUNT drawing, M5 wire-wrap post drawn the same 0.030 x .050), so hole = diagonal sqrt(0.76^2+1.27^2)=1.48 rounded up to 1.5 mm, pad = drill + 0.6. The end view is a bottom view; terminals 3 2 1 top to bottom, mirroring to the top view leaves the centred column unchanged. Slide axis drawn vertical. Mounting tabs (option B) and the M5 wire-wrap tail beyond the board are not footprint items; M5x assumed to use the M2 hole positions.

footprints.description: E-Switch 500 series DPDT slide switch, straight PC pins (M2), 2 rows of 3 pins 4.70 x 4.83 mm apart
footprints.note: 500.pdf p.2 (DPDT side view and end view 'TERM. NOS. FOR REFERENCE ONLY', M2 P.C. MOUNT drawing). The datasheet has NO PC-mounting drawing for M2, so the terminal positions are used as hole centres: 2 columns of 3 terminals, .185 (4.70) apart along the slide axis, columns .190 (4.83) apart, centred on the .450 (11.43) x .500 (12.70) case; terminal tail 0.030 (0.76) thick, narrowed to .050 (1.27) wide at the tip (p.2 M2 P.C. MOUNT drawing, M5 wire-wrap post drawn the same 0.030 x .050), so hole = diagonal sqrt(0.76^2+1.27^2)=1.48 rounded up to 1.5 mm, pad = drill + 0.6. Side view labels 6 5 4 (top to bottom) on the near column, end view (seen from the top end of the side view) shows 6 left, 3 right, so 4-5-6 is the near column and 1-2-3 the far column, pin 1 across from 4. Top view with the slide axis vertical: right = the side view's near side, so 4 5 6 on the right, 3 2 1 on the left (the 1-2-3 column's order taken to match 4-5-6, 3 at the top). Mounting tabs not footprint items. The numbering/mirroring of the two columns is read from drawings that carry no top/bottom statement.

footprints.description: E-Switch 500 series SPDT slide switch, M6 right angle PC pins, 3 pins 4.70 mm apart plus 2 frame pins 13.21 mm apart
footprints.note: 500.pdf p.3 M6 SPDT 'P.C. MOUNTING' drawing: 3 holes in a line .185 (4.70) apart at .375 (9.53) from the column of 2 frame-pin holes, which are .520 (13.21) apart and centred on the terminal line, all .073 DIA (1.85). Body .186 (4.72) deep x .500 (12.70) wide. Frame pins (support legs) are thin legs on the front face, centre taken 0.5 mm inside it (scaled from the side view), pin 0 pads, pad = drill + 0.6. Origin = centre of the case outline seen from above; the terminals lie beyond the case as they bend out of its back. The layout drawing is taken as the top view (actuator and frame pins left, terminals right). Terminal numbers are not printed on the layout; they follow the side/end views (1 = the terminal nearest the viewer in the side view, 3 = the farthest, so in the top view 3 is at the top).

footprints.description: E-Switch 500 series DPDT slide switch, M6 right angle PC pins, 2 rows of 3 pins plus 2 frame pins 13.21 mm apart
footprints.note: 500.pdf p.3 M6 DPDT 'P.C. Body .186 (4.72) deep x .500 (12.70) wide. Terminals 1 2 3 are the near column (the shorter tails) and 4 5 6 the far column (end view: 4 5 6 are the upper row), pin 4 across from 1. Frame pins (support legs) are thin legs on the front face, centre taken 0.5 mm inside it (scaled from the side view), pin 0 pads, pad = drill + 0.6. Origin = centre of the case outline seen from above; the terminals lie beyond the case as they bend out of its back. Terminal numbers are not printed on the layout; they follow the side/end views (1 = the terminal nearest the viewer in the side view, 3 = the farthest, so in the top view 3 is at the top).

footprints.description: E-Switch 500A SPDT slide switch, M2 PC pin, 3 pins 2.54 mm apart in a row
footprints.note: 500A.pdf p.2, M2 PC PIN drawing (top view 10.16 x 5.08, front view pins 1 2 3, P.C. MOUNTING: 3 holes 1.09 dia typ at 2.54 pitch). Pad = drill + 0.6 (no pad size on the drawing).

footprints.description: E-Switch 500A SPDT slide switch, M6 right angle PC pin, 3 pins 2.54 mm apart plus 2 support legs
footprints.note: 500A.pdf p.2, M6 drawing: top view (body 11.00 deep incl. epoxy x 10.16 wide), side view (support legs 4.95 and pins 10.03 from the front face, i.e. 5.08 apart), rear view labelled 3 2 1, P.C. MOUNTING: 5 holes 1.09 dia, right column 3 holes at 2.54 pitch, left column 2 holes at 5.08 (switch supports 0.76 x 0.25, no signal). Top view from above the board, actuator to the left (-x), terminals at the rear (+x); pin 1 is on the Pos. 1 side (top of the top view; the rear view 3 2 1 seen from the terminal end puts pin 1 on the Pos. 1 side). Pad = drill + 0.6. Pin x = 10.03 - 5.50, support x = 4.95 - 5.50 from the body centre.

footprints.description: E-Switch 500A SPDT slide switch, SM6 surface mount, 3 gull-wing terminals plus 2 side tabs
footprints.note: 500A.pdf p.2, SM6 SMT: P.C. MOUNTING land pattern (terminal lands 3.81 x 2.29 for pins 1 and 3 at 11.18 outer span, 1.02 x 2.29 centre land for pin 2, two tab lands 3.00 x 2.50 at 13.00 outer span, 9.07 between the rows) and top/front/side views (body 10.16 wide, 11.10 high incl. epoxy; terminals 1 2 3 left to right in the front view). The layout is drawn seen from above the board with the terminal row on top; the 3rd-angle views put the board on the viewer side of the front view, which for a top view leaves pin 1 on the left. The drawing does not place the lands relative to the body outline, so the pattern is centred on the body; the 2.03 / 2.29 land height is read as 2.29 for all three terminal lands (the drawing shows the same extent). Tab lands (no signal) are unnumbered.

footprints.description: E-Switch 500R SPDT slide switch, M2 PC thru-hole, 3 pins 2.54 mm apart in a row
footprints.note: 500R.pdf p.3, M2 Termination, Single Pole PCB Layout (3 holes 1.00 dia, 2.54 pitch, numbered 1 2 3 left to right) and Body Dimensions Vertical (housing 9.50 x 5.00, pins on the centre line). Seen from above the board. Pad = drill + 0.6.

footprints.description: E-Switch 500R DPDT slide switch, M2 PC thru-hole, 2 rows of 3 pins 2.54 mm apart

footprints.description: E-Switch 500R SPDT slide switch, M6 right angle PC thru-hole, 3 pins plus 2 support legs

footprints.description: E-Switch 600 DPDT slide switch, M4 PC pin, 2 rows of 3 pins 5.08 mm apart

footprints.description: E-Switch EG1206 slide switch SPDT, right angle, 3 pins 3.0 mm apart and 2 slotted frame tabs 12.5 mm apart

footprints.description: E-Switch EG1215 slide switch SPDT, surface mount right angle, 3 gull wing pads 1.5 / 3.0 mm apart, 4 frame feet, 2 locating holes
footprints.note: EG1215.pdf p.2 'Surface Mount PCB Layout' (top view): signal pads 0.70 x 1.50 at x = -2.25, +0.75, +2.25 (2.25 / 3.00 / 1.50 dimensions from the centre line), y = -1.75 (centre of the pad row 1.75 above the centre line); four frame-foot pads 1.00 x 0.80 at x = +-3.65 (inner edges +-3.15, 6.30 apart), y = +-1.05 (1.30 gap between the pairs); two Ø0.90 locating holes at x = +-1.50 on the centre line, drawn plain (not marked unplated) so modelled as plated pin-0 holes, pad = drill + 0.6. Origin = the layout's centre lines, which coincide with the body centre (body 6.70 x 2.60 from the top view; the terminals exit the rear edge 0.90 and land in the 1.50 tall pads). Layout read as seen from above the board.

footprints.description: E-Switch EGJ1210 slide switch SPDT, through hole, 3 pins 2.54 mm apart
footprints.note: EGJ1210.pdf p.2 (T1 Through Hole): Through Hole PCB Layout: three 0.80 dia holes, 2.54 pitch. Front view labels the pins 2 1 3 left to right (pin 1, the common, in the middle). Body 10.00 x 2.50 from the top view (the 1.00 dia hole in the housing tab is not a PCB feature). Pins centred on the body depth (side view). Pad = drill + 0.6.

footprints.description: E-Switch EGJ1210 slide switch SPDT, through hole right angle, 3 pins 2.54 mm apart, board against the switch's rear face
footprints.note: EGJ1210.pdf p.3 (T2 Through Hole Right Angle): Through Hole PCB Layout: three 0.80 dia holes, 2.54 pitch. The leads leave the rear face horizontally (top view: 3.3 long), so the board plane is perpendicular to them and the footprint is the view along the leads (the front view, as seen from the component side): body = 10.00 x 5.00 (front view, excluding the 1.40 actuator); the lead strips run 0.40 below the body bottom (side view 7.1 from the actuator top, body top 1.40 below it, body 5.00 tall), so the holes are 3.00 below the body centre. Front view labels the pins 2 1 3 left to right. Assumption: the datasheet PCB layout gives only the hole pitch; the offset to the body is read off the side/front views. Pad = drill + 0.6.

footprints.description: E-Switch EGJ1210 slide switch SPDT, surface mount gull wing, 3 pads 2.54 mm apart, pin 1 on the rear edge
footprints.note: EGJ1210.pdf p.4 (G1 Gull Wing): Surface Mount PCB Layout (top view): three 1.00 x 3.00 pads at 2.54 pitch, pad 1 (centre) 2.20 behind pads 2 and 3, 5.20 overall. Position against the body is not dimensioned: the leads' extent (side view 4.7 long = 5.20 less 0.25 per end) is assumed centred on the 2.50 deep body (side view overhang 1.1 / 1.2 each side), so pad 1 is at y = -1.10 and pads 2, 3 at y = +1.10 (top view: pin 1's lead leaves the rear edge, 2 and 3 the front edge). Body 10.00 x 2.50 from the top view. Pins 2 1 3 left to right.

footprints.description: E-Switch EGJ1210 slide switch SPDT, surface mount gull wing right angle, 3 pads 2.54 mm apart in a row
footprints.note: EGJ1210.pdf p.5 (G2 Gull Wing Right Angle): Surface Mount PCB Layout (top view): three 1.00 x 3.00 pads in a row at 2.54 pitch. The drawing does not dimension the pads against the body; assumed centred on the body (side view: foot tip 2.6 from the front face of the 2.5 deep body, 3.0 pad = foot plus toe margin, centre within 0.1 mm of the body centre). Body 10.00 x 2.50 from the top view. Pins 2 1 3 left to right.
